Page 002
002-1. AH,HE'S SUNG JINWOO.AHUNTER WHORECENTLY BECAMEAN S-RANK.
002-2. IS HE AN ASSASSIN-TYPE HUNTER?
002-3. BUT EVEN IF HE WERE, HIS PRESENCE CANNOT EASILY BE HIDDEN,
002-4. HEMUSTBEQUITE ANEXCEPTIONAL ASSASSIN.
002-5. PARDON? HE'S A MAGE-TYPE HUNTER,SIR.

Page 003
003-1. A MAGE-TYPE?
003-2. THAT'SNOT POSSIBLE...
003-3. IT'S BEENOFFICIALLY CONFIRMED.
003-4. LOOK WHO'S HERE.
003-5. ISN'T THAT SUNG JINWOO, THE GUY WHO RUINED MINSUNG'S DEBUT?
003-6. SUNG JINWOO?
003-7. I KNEW IT...HE'S THE REASON THE AIR FELT DIFFERENT.

Page 004
004-1. KEI, THAT HUNTER OVERTHEREISSOUTH KOREA'S1OTHS-RANK HUNTER.
004-2. DON'T TALK TO ME, ISHIDA.
004-3. IFEELLIKETHROWING UPBECAUSEOFALLTHE S-RANKSGATHERED HERE.
004-4. I SEE THERE'S A SOUTH KOREAN HUNTER WITH A NOSE AS SENSITIVE AS MINE.
004-5. SHE'S ONLY USING A HANDKERCHIEF, THOUGH.. SHE MUST THOUGH...SHE MUST BE A FEW TIERS BELOW ME.
004-6. IF I TRY AND STRIKE UP A CONVERSATION, WOULD SHE THINK I'M HITTING ONHER?
004-7. IF ONLY I HAD LEARNED SOME KOREAN BEFOREHAND...

Page 005
005-1. TON
005-2. THESE HUNTERS ARECONSIDERED SOUTHKOREA'S STRONGEST?
005-3. THEY'RE MEDIOCREAT BEST.
005-4. YOU THINK SO?
005-5. MR.GOTO.I'VE BEEN WATCHINGYOURRAIDS FROMTHESIDELINESFOR QUITESOMETIMENOW.
005-6. PERHAPSTHIS IS THE REASONWHYI'MNO LONGERIMPRESSED BYS-RANKS.

Page 006
006-1. ICAN'T SAY I AGREE WITH YOU.
006-2. THERESEEMS TO BEONENOTABLE HUNTEROVER THERE.
006-3. CHA HAE-IN, WAS IT
006-4. CHA HAE-IN AND GO GUNHEE.THESE TWO WOULD GIVE OUR BEST HUNTERS A RUN FOR THEIRMONEY
006-5. OI, MISS INTERPRETER, WHAT'D YA SAY JUST NOW?

Page 007
007-1. YA THINK THE SOUTH KOREAN HUNTERS ARE ALL MEDIOCRE?
007-2. DIDYA THINKI WOULDN'T UNDERSTAND 'CAUSE YOU WERE SPEAKING IN JAPANESE?
007-3. I'LL HAVE YA KNOW THAT I LEARNEDJAPANESE IN HIGH SCHOOL AS MY SECOND LANGUAGE.
007-4. GO GET 'EM, BOSS!
007-5. AND YOU ARE.?
007-6. WINS3P N23E 111
007-7. THIS MAN RIGHT HERE IS THE GUILD MASTER OF THE KNIGHTS GUILD!

Page 008
008-1. MR.PARK JONGSOO!
008-2. PARK  JONGSOO (A-RANK) GUILD MASTER OF THE KNIGHTS GUILD
008-3. PARK JONGSOO? I'VE NEVER HEARD OF YOU BEFORE...
008-4. W,WELL... MR.PARKIS AN A-RANK,NOTAN S-RANK,SO MAYBE THAT'S WHY YOU HAVEN'T HEARD OF HIM!
008-5. OUR GUILDIS ONE OF THE FIVE MAJOR GUILDSIN SOUTH KOREA, THOUGH!
008-6. AND OUT OF ALL THE GUILDS,WE'VE RECRUITEDTHE LARGEST NUMBER OFA-RANK HUNTERS!
008-7. YOONTAE, THAT'S ENOUGH SHOWING OFF.
008-8. A SOUTH KOREAN △-RANK HINTER.

Page 009
009-1. HUH...?
009-2. WILL YOUBE JOINING THE RAID IN JEJU AS WELL?
009-3. I THOUGHT ONLY S-RANKHUNTERS WERE ALLOWED TO PARTICIPATE...
009-4. URGH...

Page 010
010-1. HANEKAWA. WHATARE YOUALL TALKING ABOUT RIGHTNOW?
010-2. MR.PARK IS ON THE DEFENSE TEAM! HE'S GONNA BE IN CHARGE OF BLOCKING OFF THE ISLAND!
010-3. HMM,THAT'S GOOD TO HEAR. CAN'T ASSIGN ANIMPORTANT TASK TO AN A-RANK.
010-4. HANEKAWA. IFYOU'REBEING DISCOURTEOUSRIGHT NOW,PLEASESTOP
010-5. KNOCK IT OFF, WILL YA? SHE'S JUST AN INTERPRETER TAGGIN' ALONG.WHAT WOULD SHE KNOW?

Page 011
011-1. WOULDYOU LIKE TO TRY ME?
011-2. MY NAMEIS HANEKAWAANDI'M AN A-RANK HUNTER FROM JAPAN.
011-3. DON'T TELL ME YOU CAN'T TAKE ON A MERE INTERPRETER THAT'S SIMPLY "TAGGING ALONG."

Page 012
012-1. FOR CHRIST'S SAKE.LOOK,MISS INTERPRETER.
012-2. ENOUGH WITH THE DISSING.
012-3. AREYOUA NON-COMBATANT HUNTER?
012-4. A FIGHT BETWEEN A JAPANESE A-RANK HUNTER...
012-5. .AND A SOUTH KOREAN A-RANK HUNTER?

Page 013
013-1. LOOKS LIKE THINGS ARE ABOUTTO GET INTERESTING.
013-2. ...FINE, BUT LET'S LAY DOWN SOME RULES.
013-3. BETTER THAN JUST AIMLESSLY DUKIN'IT OUT, DON'T YA THINK?
013-4. THE RULES ARE SIMPLE.
013-5. THE FIRST PERSON TO GRAB THE OPPONENT'S WRIST WINS.
013-6. RAISE

Page 014
014-1. THE ONE WHO GETS THEIR WRIST CAUGHT LOSES.

Page 015
015-1. EVEN IF I GO IN THROWING PUNCHES AT HIM, THE FIGHT WILL BE OVER IF HE GRABS ME.
015-2. LOOKS LIKE I WON'T BE ABLE TO ATTACK RIGHT AWAY.
015-3. I GUESS WE'LL HAVE TO PLAY MIND GAMES WITH EACH OTHER.
015-4. BY THE WAY,
015-5. YOU CALL THATAREADY STANCE?

Page 016
016-1. DON'T YA WORRY, I'M NOT GONNA TAKE THIS HAND OUT UNLESS IT'S TO GRAB YOUR WRIST.
016-2. SO HE'S CONFIDENT IN HIS SPEED.
016-3. ALL RIGHT, LET'S BEGIN.

Page 017

Page 018
018-1. WSH
018-2. I'M GOING TO WIPE THAT PRETENTIOUS LOOK OFF HIS FACE!
018-3. WOo /

Page 019
019-1. OH,FOR THE RECORD,I DIDN'T HIT YA.
019-2. IT WAS JUST A LIL SHOVE.
019-3. YA KNOW WHAT I'M SAYING, RIGHT?

Page 020
020-1. SORRY, BUT I'M HAVING A HARD TIME UNDERSTANDING YOUR ACCENT.

Page 021
021-1. OH,AND YOULOOK LAME TRYING TO ACT ALL COOL IN THOSE RIPPED PANTS.
021-2. NOW'S MY CHANCE!
021-3. TOO SLOW, MISS INTERPRETER.

Page 022
022-1. GRAB,
022-2. WHAT HAPPENED JUST NOW?
022-3. TREMBLE
022-4. YOU'RE THE TYPE OF HUNTER THAT ALWAYS HIDES BEHIND THEM TANKS,EH?
022-5. TREMBLE

Page 023
023-1. IT ALSO SEEMS LIKE YOU'VE GOTNO ONE-ON-ONE COMBAT EXPERIENCE.

Page 024
024-1. HERE IN SOUTH KOREA,WE RUN INTO TROUBLEMAKERS EVERY NOW AND THEN,
024-2. WHICH MEANS WE SOMETIMES HAVE TO FIGHT OUR OWN KIND.
024-3. WHEN WORSE COMES TO WORST, WE EVEN GOTTA KILL 'EM SOMETIMES.
024-4. UNLIKE MAGIC BEASTS, THE WAY A HUMAN MOVES AIN'T SO SIMPLE, SO YOU'RE DEAD MEAT IF YOU CAN'T PREDICT YOUR OPPONENT'S NEXT MOVE. NOD.
024-5. IF I WEREWIELDIN' A SWORD,I WOULD'VE SLICED YOUR THROAT, NOT YOUR WRIST.
024-6. SNATCH
024-7. ...HMPH.

Page 025
025-1. THANKYOU.WHAT ANEXCITING MATCH THAT WAS.
025-2. HANEKAWA,WOULD YOUPLEASERELAYMY WORDS TOEVERYONE HERE?
025-3. AH,OF COURSE.
025-4. IN THE INTEREST OF BUILDING TRUST BETWEEN OURTWO COUNTRIES, I HAVE A PROPOSAL FOR YOU.

Page 026
026-1. WHAT DO YOU SAY WE HAVE OUR S-RANK HUNTERS...
026-2. .SPAR ONE ANOTHER ACCORDING TO THE RULES USED JUST NOW?

Page 027
027-1. I GUESS HE WANTS TO SEE HOW STRONG WE ALL ARE.
027-2. SOUNDS GOOD.
027-3. HOWEVER,LET'S EXCLUDE THE MAGE-TYPE ANDNON-COMBATANT HUNTERS,SINCE IT'D BE DIFFICULT TO TELL WHO WON.
027-4. LET'S ALSOADD A FEW MORE RULES WHILE WE'RE ATIT.
027-5. YOU WIN IF YOU TOUCH YOUR OPPONENT'S WRIST OR BACK,OR IF YOU KNOCK THEM DOWN.
027-6. LET'S ALSO HAVE MULTIPLE HUNTERS GO AGAINST EACH OTHER, INSTEAD OF HAVING ONE-ON-ONE MATCHES.

Page 028
028-1. SO THAT MEANS YOU CAN'T PICK AND CHOOSE YOUR OPPONENT. HOWDOES THAT SOUND?
028-2. WITH THESE NEW RULES, KNOCKING OUT ONE PERSON WOULD BE ENOUGH TO TURN THE TIDES...
028-3. BUT THEN AGAIN, THE ASSASSIN-TYPE HUNTERS WOULD HAVE TOO MUCH OF AN ADVANTAGE OTHERWISE...
028-4. ALLRIGHT, SOUNDS GOOD.
028-5. KOREA WILL SEND OUT BAEK YOONHO, MA DONGWOOK, CHA HAE-IN,AND LIM TAE-GYU.

Page 029
029-1. WHO WILL PARTICIPATE FROM THE JAPANESE SIDE?

Page 030
030-1. TANAKA KENZO, HOSHINO MINORU, KUMAMOTOATSUSHI, AND TAWATA KANAE.
030-2. JAPAN WILL SEND OUT THESE FOUR HUNTERS.

Page 031

031-2. -AGUILDTHATISACTIVEINTHEYEONGNAM REGION. -OUTOF SOUTH KOREA'SFIVEMAJOR GUILDS, THEKNIGHTSRANKFIFTH. -ALTHOUGHTHEGUILDMASTERISNOTAN S-RANK,THEKNIGHTSHAVERECRUITEDTHE HIGHESTNUMBEROFA-RANKHUNTERSIN THECOUNTRY.
